name: Clockwerk Run
summary: In Gnomeregan, toxic fumes and irradiated troggs choke Clockwerk Run between the Train Depot and the Hall of Gears.

sections.title: A Ruined Threshold
sections.body:
Clockwerk Run carries you from the outer Train Depot into Gnomeregan. Once, gnomish traffic and supplies passed through this corridor. Then High Tinker Mekkatorque ordered radioactive waste vented to stop the trogg invasion. The waste turned the passage into a deadly trap.

The blast and the fighting that followed brought parts of the hallway down. Toxic fumes and irradiated troggs now block the way to the upper Hall of Gears.

faq.q: Where does the Clockwerk Run lead?
faq.answer: Clockwerk Run connects the Train Depot outside the deep vaults to the upper Hall of Gears inside Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Why are there so many troggs here?
faq.answer: Troggs surged through Gnomeregan's lower passages during the invasion. In Clockwerk Run, vented radioactive waste made them violent and irradiated, and they attack anyone entering the city.

faq.q: Why is the corridor partially caved in?
faq.answer: Fighting during Gnomeregan's fall and the release of toxic counter-measures badly damaged the perimeter. Parts of the corridor collapsed.

angles.text: As a gnome, passing through Clockwerk Run brings the fall of your capital close. The desperate attempt to cleanse the city changed the invaders instead of destroying them.
As an engineer, the ruined machinery and collapsed structures along Clockwerk Run show what explosive force and radiation can do to gnomish mechanisms.
